name: Ore ga Shujinkou ~Naka ni Haitte Ore ga Dasu!~
original_name: 俺が主人公～ナカに入って俺がダす！～
source:
The protagonist is a helpless NEET who is also an otaku. One day, 2 angels Kuu and Yuna came from the 2D world to change him by teaching him about Love and Life, because they are aware of the protagonist's future.

What will Kuu and Yuna do to change him?

[translated/edited from [url=http://www.kaorinusantara.web.id/forum/showthread.php?t=18818] KAORI Nusantara[/url]]

An interactive 3D Visual Novel from ILLUSION
